system.description:
You've got informants everywhere — you don't even need to go looking for secrets anymore, since they come to you. The rumors and dirty little details you collect may seem useless right now, but may prove pivotal later, giving you a lead that puts you one step ahead of everyone else. This Background may be purchased during the freebie point phase of character creation with Storyteller permission. It functions separately from the Contacts Background: Information Network draws only on local rumor mills, water-cooler gossip, and the general grapevine, while Contacts represents a specific, targeted source of Influence.

System: At the beginning of each session, make a Simple Test with the Storyteller. If you win, the Storyteller gives you a bit of information that has been floating around your network (which may or may not relate to the current story). Alternately, the Storyteller may allow you to spend this once per session as an active "ear to the ground" to dig for something related to your current interest — though what comes back need not actually relate to the subject at hand, or even be true. The Storyteller may require you to detail who or what makes up your network. At the Storyteller's option, these same rules may also be applied to the Contacts Background.
system.source: Clanbook: Nosferatu, Chapter One ("Legends and History"), "New Background: Information Network"
